Changelog

Notable changes to the Karma Common API, newest first. Each entry corresponds to a published revision of the API reference.

2026-07-18

Changed — Inventory item and location API references now describe generic metadata on create, update, and read operations.

Added — Item and location metadata guides cover shallow merging, metadata filtering, and customer BigQuery join patterns.

2026-06-28

Added — Bulk surplus upload endpoint for pushing surplus from your own POS.

2026-06-23

Added — Order line items expose per-item vatRateBasisPoints and vatAmountCents.

2026-06-16

Added — Per-line-item VAT (vatRateBasisPoints, vatAmountCents) on purchases.

2026-05-31

Added — Public Order endpoint (place an order), with a worked example.

2026-05-12

Added — Initial public API reference, examples, and getting-started guide.

Last modified on July 16, 2026
